product_metadata.title: HOMEST XL Nylon Laundry Bag, Machine Washable Large Dirty Clothes Organizer, Easy Fit a Laundry Hamper or Basket, Can Carry Up to 4 Loads of Laundry, Black
features: ULTRA LARGE CAPACITY - Measure 28''×40''; This size is big enough for holding 3~4 loads of laundry, storage in the college dorm or family use

RIP-STOP AND PREVENT UNRAVEL - Extra-tough double-seam construction and thick nylon material that prevents the bag tears from spreading; Plastic head at the end of the rope to make the drawstring not easy to unravel
EASY CLOSURE - A locking drawstring closure can prevent the spill of items and tie the knot after close can keep the clothes more safe and secure in the bag while carrying laundry
PROTECTS HAMPERS FROM ODOR - This hamper liner helps hampers stay cleaner and fresher smelling because dirty laundry is not in direct contact with the material of the hamper

WHAT CAN WE USE IT? - Great choice for sleep away summer camp, kids can hold week period dirty clothes and take them back home, easily folded flat for future use. Multipurpose bags also can storage your bedding, towels, off season clothes, toys, blankets, pillows
